ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 80% of the visible surface, with sharp macro-level contrast against low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and a central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the core of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous boundary along the trailing edges and a fragmented vertical stripe through the median notch. Small focal black spots and mottling are concentrated near the distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a clearly defined vertex; depth occupies approximately 12-15% of the total fluke vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3-10 pixels; contains multiple distinct peak-and-valley sequences across both lobes' continuous linear boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curves extending from the median notch, transitioning to a slight taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast yellowish and tan pixel clusters (potential scarring) distributed across the white field of the right lobe. High-intensity white/gray 3D clusters (barnacles) are localized at the far distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the right lobe and mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization at both distal tips; distinct irregular notch/indentation on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique broken vertical black pigmentation pattern extending from the base of the median notch towards the water line.
